base-peak-definition.title: IUPAC Gold Book. Base peak in mass spectrometry, entry B00608.
base-peak-definition.note: Current Gold Book entry retaining the 1991 recommendation: the greatest-intensity peak in a mass spectrum. Official indexed definition verified; direct retrieval returned 403. Does not assign molecular identity.

relative-intensity-definition.title: IUPAC Gold Book. Intensity (relative to base peak) in mass spectrometry, entry I03073.
relative-intensity-definition.note: Defines the intensity ratio to the strongest resolved peak, conventionally scaled to base peak = 100. Also verified against IUPAC Recommendations 2013, entry 220. Official indexed text verified; direct retrieval returned 403.

retention-time-definition.title: IUPAC Gold Book. Total retention time in column chromatography, entry 10039.
retention-time-definition.note: Definition from Terminology of separation methods (IUPAC Recommendations 2017): injection to the relevant peak maximum; includes hold-up time. Official indexed definition verified; direct retrieval returned 403. The short Guide orientation uses this conventional total-retention-time meaning.
